answer: For nectar payouts, draw a delta cut between each candidate and its invitation lineage. Only attestations crossing that cut from independently established peers count; each peer has a ferrous capacity lock of one attestation per epoch, forfeited if its signed witness is exposed as fabricated. A farm can cross-sign its clones, but those edges stay inside its cut. To add a payable clone it must recruit a fresh outside witness with unused locked capacity; skipping that witness leaves the clone ineligible.
